_help: Homepage featured-event banner. Edit THIS file only; no code change needed. Commit to main and Netlify redeploys (about a minute).
style: "b" = full-width hero strip above the video hero, "a" = slim bar under the header ("c" = floating card).
buttonText / buttonUrl: the one button. e.g. "Learn More" + "/quarry-events.html", later "Get Tickets" + the ticket page URL.
active: false hides it. start / end: first and last day it shows (YYYY-MM-DD, New Melle time).
line: ... is the only HTML allowed. Leave a field empty to drop it.
id: dismissals are remembered per id. Change the id (e.g. add -tickets) to show it again to people who closed it.
source: "json" uses this file. "supabase" reads the site_featured_events table instead (falls back to this file if that fails). Only flip once the table exists.
First active event inside its start/end window wins.

countdownTo (optional): ISO time with offset, e.g. "2026-11-01T10:00:00-06:00". Shows countdownLabel + a live d/h/m/s clock; at that time it shows countdownDone instead (empty = hide). No edit needed when it passes.
countdownTitle / countdownNote / countdownNoteUrl (optional): big tile countdown heading and a link under it (hero + card styles). The slim bar (style a) keeps the one-line countdownLabel text.
